#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

bool check(int w, int m, int pos, int carry) {
    if (pos > 100) {
        return carry != 1;
    }
    int digit = m % w;
    int nextM = m / w;
    digit += carry;
    carry = digit / w;
    digit %= w;
    if (digit == 0 || digit == 1) {
        return check(w, nextM, pos + 1, carry);
    }
    if (digit == w - 1) {
        return check(w, nextM, pos + 1, 1);
    }
    return false;
}

int main() {
    int w, m;
    cin >> w >> m;
    cout << (check(w, m, 0, 0) ? "YES" : "NO");
    return 0;
}
